#
#  Stream Interaction List from 1995 to the end of 2023. 
#
#  The original description of the list can be found in 
#    Koller et al. 2022 (JGR):
#    Magnetosheath Jet Occurrence Rate in Relation to CMEs and SIRs  
#    https://doi.org/10.1029/2021JA030124 
#
#  The list is extended in the following work:
#    Koller, F., Simon Wedlund, C., Temmer, M., Svenningsson, I., Preisser, L., 
#    Pöppelwerth, A., Simon, P. A., Vörös, Z., Chen, C. H. K., Roberts, O. W.,  
#    Plaschke, F.:    
#    Stability of the Earth’s Dayside Magnetosheath: Effects of Upstream 
#    Solar Wind Structures and Downstream Jets
#    submitted to JGR, 2025
# 
#  This list is limited by OMNI availability and does not claim completeness 
#  of all events 
#
#  The columns contain:
#    column 1: Start of pressure increase  in UT
#    column 2: peak of velocity in UT
#    column 3 end of high-speed stream (falls below defined threshold) in UT
#    column 4: source of event
#    column 5: comments 
#
#  Time format: yyyy-mm-dd/hh:mm:ss
